message:
Yes—Plan B is better if you want later morning starts.

- Plan A: CAP4000 meets Monday/Wednesday, 8–9:15 a.m.; Tuesday/Thursday mornings are free.
- Plan B: CAP4000 meets Tuesday/Thursday, 10–11:40 a.m. Your first Monday class is at 10 a.m., and Wednesday starts at 1 p.m.

B avoids all 8 a.m. classes, but adds Tuesday attendance and leaves only 20 minutes before your noon work shifts. A concentrates classes into three weekdays; B uses four.

Both remain feasible at 13 credits, including the required course and lab. I favor B for later starts if the commute to work fits those 20 minutes. Your saved Plan A and current enrollment remain unchanged.
